title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls: Courtesy Bonus Award for Consecutive Comfort Club Terms
content:
A courtesy-program customer with a long Comfort Club record earns a courtesy bonus award toward the courtesy rate on a paid tune-up under Repair and Emergency Service Calls. The record read is the customer's agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements: its status and its consecutive terms, which count the current term and are held without a break.

**Rule.** A customer whose active Comfort Club agreement has run eight or more consecutive terms earns a courtesy bonus award of 4 points. One whose active agreement has run four to seven consecutive terms earns 2 points. Any other customer earns no award.

| Active agreement, consecutive terms | Courtesy bonus award |
|---|---|
| 8 or more | 4 points |
| 4 to 7 | 2 points |
| 1 to 3, or no active agreement | None |

## Boundaries

- The 8th consecutive term earns 4 points. The 7th earns 2.
- The 4th consecutive term earns 2 points. The 3rd earns none.
